rewrites.//: Only rewrite paths that aren't real files. The negative lookahead skips anything with a dot in the last segment (e.g. /laserhands.html, /assets/index-abc.js, favicon.ico) so Vercel serves them as-is instead of returning index.html. The catch-all `/(.*)` rewrite we had before caused MIME-type errors on mobile when a JS chunk request raced the file-system check and got the SPA shell back.
